name: b-fac
description: A factory for running real projects with agents: orchestration workflows packaged to work across coding harnesses rather than only inside one.

plugins.name: b-fac
plugins.description: Run a project as an orchestrator driving implementation subagents against a GitHub issue backlog: break work into issues, brief agents that work in isolated worktrees, verify what comes back rather than accepting it, and merge through a path that mechanically refuses red checks.
